name: Bigger Every Step! 🎯
desc:
🚶‍♂️ Walk and Become a Giant! 🌟
Are you ready for an incredible adventure where you grow bigger with every step?
In this unique game, your character actually grows as you walk! 
Start as a tiny character and transform into a massive giant!

Game Features:
- Your height increases as you move
- Reach enormous sizes
- Race with friends and see who becomes the biggest
- Ever-growing experience
- Simple but addictive gameplay

The more you walk, the bigger you grow!
 So how tall can you become?
Join now and start becoming a giant!
